description: This file defines the ElasticsearchQueryFieldTypeProvider class, which implements ISchemaBuilder to dynamically build GraphQL schema fields based on Elasticsearch queries. It includes methods for constructing field types from query schemas and content types, and resolves query execution asynchronously.

classes.name: ElasticsearchQueryFieldTypeProvider
classes.description: A class that builds GraphQL query fields based on Elasticsearch queries, implementing ISchemaBuilder.

methods.name: GetIdentifierAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier for the query source asynchronously.

methods.name: BuildAsync
methods.description: Builds GraphQL query fields dynamically based on registered Elasticsearch queries.

methods.name: BuildSchemaBasedFieldType
methods.description: Constructs a GraphQL field type from a query schema JSON object.

methods.name: BuildContentTypeFieldType
methods.description: Constructs a GraphQL field type for content items based on content type.
